setup_guard.value: You can evaluate the baseline without configuring it first.
setup_guard.note: Advisory reminder when `configured: false` (rate-limited). Never blocks.

destructive_cmd_guard.value: A catastrophic command never reaches your shell.
destructive_cmd_guard.note: Hard-block catastrophic commands; ask on risky. Also closes the Bash surface of consent: writes to a consent path, and epic `approved` flips.

git_commit_guard.article: Art. IV gate C, Art. VII
git_commit_guard.value: Claude cannot rewrite published history, or commit on a protected branch without consent.
git_commit_guard.note: Branch-aware consent; hard-block forbidden flags; gate consent writes; hard-block a closing commit whose staged `backlog.md` lacks the `source_backlog_keys` closure stamp. (annex)

gitignore_leak_guard.value: A file you told git to ignore cannot be staged into a commit.
gitignore_leak_guard.note: Hard-block a commit staging a must-ignore path. Fail-closed on an inspection error; fail-open on missing baseline data.

direction_approval_guard.value: Claude cannot approve its own direction.
direction_approval_guard.note: Allow direction-approval token write only on fresh marker; block self-approval + marker writes; opt-in provenance-anchor arm. (annex)

swarm_approval_guard.value: Parallel dispatch waits until you authorize it.
swarm_approval_guard.note: Allow swarm-approval write only on fresh marker; block marker writes

epic_approval_guard.value: An epic cannot mark itself approved.
epic_approval_guard.note: Allow an epic-state `approved: true` flip only when the matching `spec_approvals/<slug>.approval` token exists; other writes pass. (annex)

verify_pass_guard.value: A failing test suite cannot be written up as passing.
verify_pass_guard.note: Block writing PASS to verify artifacts when truth source says FAIL

track_guard.value: A phase cannot run before the phase it depends on.

branch_guard.value: Work cannot start on a release branch under PR discipline.
branch_guard.note: Deny `workflow.json` creation on a release branch under `github-flow`; fail-open otherwise

state_write_guard.value: A subagent cannot widen what it is allowed to do next.
state_write_guard.note: Deny a subagent write to `.claude/state/**` on both the Bash and edit-tool boundaries; reads and the main session pass

artifact_template_guard.value: A spec or intake missing its required sections never lands.
artifact_template_guard.note: Block artifact writes missing required `##` sections

plantuml_syntax_guard.value: You learn a diagram is broken at the boundary when strict checking is on.
plantuml_syntax_guard.note: Advisory by default (no JVM); strict `java -checkonly` only when `plantuml.strict_syntax_check` true.

spec_diagram_presence_guard.value: A spec cannot skip a diagram it is required to draw.
spec_diagram_presence_guard.note: Block specs missing required diagram kinds

spec_design_calls_guard.value: A UI spec cannot ship without naming what it designs against.
spec_design_calls_guard.note: Block UI specs whose `## Design calls` rows lack a Reference target/Quality criteria

swarm_boundary_guard.value: A parallel worker cannot write outside the files it was given.
swarm_boundary_guard.note: Enforce write_set discipline whenever a wave is active (both isolation modes)

tdd_order_guard.value: No source file appears without a test.
tdd_order_guard.note: Require test before new source file

process_lifecycle_guard.value: You see what this project already learned about a command before you run it.
process_lifecycle_guard.note: Advisory. Bash leg surfaces process-management entries by category and key; write leg carries three triggers — phase-scoped, path-governed, and corpus location. Never blocks. (annex)

lint_runner.value: Lint runs on every code change once the project is configured.
lint_runner.note: Run `lint.cmd` on code changes (guide mode until configured); `exit 2` on failure

test_runner.value: Tests run on every code change once the project is configured.
test_runner.note: Run `test.cmd` on code changes (guide mode until configured); `exit 2` on failure

phase_timer.value: You can see where a workflow spent its time.
phase_timer.note: Observe-only; stamps per-phase timing on `completed[]` growth, incl. Bash-driven `workflow.json` writes. Never blocks or mutates.

memory_session_start.value: A new session starts knowing what the last one learned.
memory_session_start.note: Inject memory index + resume snapshot at session start

memory_stop.value: What you decide in conversation is captured before the session ends.

harness_continuation.value: A workflow interrupted mid-flow picks itself back up.
harness_continuation.note: Disjunctive gate: Path A re-fires `Skill(harness)` when the loop stopped mid-flow, Path B resumes after a consent command. Silent on `parked` and `done`; never writes consent. (annex)

memory_pre_compact.value: A compaction cannot lose your place.
memory_pre_compact.note: Capture resume snapshot before context compaction

consent_gate_grant.article: Art. IV gates A/B/C, Art. VII
consent_gate_grant.note: Detect consent commands in user input and write the gate marker, OUTSIDE Claude's tool boundary
